name: Runner Extras - External Business Event
brief: Issue #5149: raising an [ExternalBusinessEvent] died with a NullReferenceException out of NavSqlConnectionScope.TryOpenConnection, because BC's subscription lookup opens a SQL connection. The runner now completes the raise and delivers nothing, as a CI service tier does where no subscription can exist (docs/scope.md#external-business-events). This suite pins that the raise returns, that the AL around it runs, and that an unrelated error in the same procedure still propagates.
description: Runner-specific by construction: a production service tier with a Dataverse subscription would deliver the event; the runner never does.
